hero.title: Gramin: Where Authentic Vegetarian Cuisine Blossoms
hero.subtitle: Discover a symphony of fresh, wholesome flavors crafted with tradition and passion. At Gramin, every dish is a celebration of nature's bounty, inviting you to a truly memorable dining experience.

about.title: The Gramin Story: A Legacy of Flavor & Freshness
about.paragraph1: At Gramin, we believe in the power of plants to create extraordinary culinary experiences. Our journey began with a simple philosophy: to serve authentic, soul-satisfying vegetarian dishes made from the freshest ingredients, upholding traditional recipes passed down through generations. Every plate served at Gramin is a testament to our dedication to quality and taste.
about.paragraph2: More than just a restaurant, Gramin is a vibrant community space where friends and family gather to share joyful moments and delectable meals. We are committed to fostering a warm, inviting atmosphere where every guest feels at home, celebrating the rich diversity and delightful simplicity of vegetarian cuisine. Join us at Gramin and taste the difference passion makes.
